register_ToMaskConverter_for_chart_outpu: register ToMaskConverter to convert DensePoseChartPredictorOutput to BitMasks using fine and coarse segmentation
register_ToMaskConverter_for_embedding_o: register ToMaskConverter to convert DensePoseEmbeddingPredictorOutput to BitMasks using coarse segmentation only
register_ToChartResultConverter: register ToChartResultConverter to convert DensePoseChartPredictorOutput to DensePoseChartResult with UV coordinates
register_ToChartResultConverterWithConfi: register ToChartResultConverterWithConfidences to convert DensePoseChartPredictorOutput to results including confidence scores
register_HFlipConverter: register HFlipConverter to horizontally flip DensePoseChartPredictorOutput tensors and remap semantic labels
